description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 scores (%) of various models across different datasets, with the x-axis representing the datasets (SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, WADI) and the y-axis showing the F1 score ranging from 60 to 100%. Each dataset has four bars representing different model configurations: MADLLM (green), MADLLM w/o prompt pool (blue), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (orange). For most datasets, MADLLM achieves the highest F1 score, followed by MADLLM w/o skip embedding, MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and MADLLM w/o prompt pool. The F1 scores for MADLLM are consistently high, ranging from approximately 94% to 100%, while the other configurations show lower scores, particularly MADLLM w/o prompt pool, which has the lowest scores across all datasets. The chart highlights the importance of each component in the MADLLM model, with the full model outperforming all variations.
